prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A teenage basketball player stands at the entrance of a dimly lit indoor gymnasium, partially framed by the dark tunnel leading onto the court. He wears a maroon basketball uniform with white trim, featuring the bold text "LEONES CON FLOW" across the chest and a circular team emblem on both the jersey and shorts. The player holds a basketball loosely at his side, his posture relaxed and slightly slouched, with a contemplative or uncertain expression on his face as he gazes off to the side. The background reveals the geometric lines and railings of the gym, with empty bleachers and muted colors that emphasize the solitary, introspective mood. The lighting is soft and naturalistic, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the maroon and white of the uniform against the darker tunnel. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, subtly blurring the foreground and background to draw focus to the central figure, evoking a cinematic, coming-of-age atmosphere.
